title: Single hieratic sign, London, British Museum, EA 10474 rto (AKU HT 71336)

source.attribution: Facsimile by Ursula Verhoeven; AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 71336

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 71336; AKU grapheme H0040 (AKU GR 300). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: H4 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 231.
